profile.belief: I've always been drawn to entertainment because of its ability to bring people together and create lasting impact. I started as an independent artist and discovered that music could open doors far beyond a song itself. Today, my work sits at the intersection of music, live experiences, film, hospitality, and community building. I'm most energized by creating platforms that connect artists, fans, brands, and institutions in meaningful ways.
profile.working_on: My goal is to build globally recognized entertainment properties that create opportunities for others. Whether that's through live experiences, film, music, or strategic partnerships, I'm interested in building things that last. Personally, I want to continue growing as an artist, producer, and entrepreneur while developing platforms that elevate emerging talent and create meaningful cultural experiences around the world.
